impacts.description: Advances in model architecture, memory, reasoning, and autonomous behaviour are paving the way to unlocking AI agent potential across economic sectors, contributing to the Apply AI Strategy.
Contribution to the Apply AI Strategy as acknowledged in the call, advancing research on next-generation AI agents for real-world application sectors.

Results validated in Testing and Experiment Facilities and deployed via European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs), contributing to technological uptake across sectors including healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving.
Communicable results shared with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform, strengthening the European AI research ecosystem.
Contribution to the co-programmed European Partnership on AI, Data and Robotics (ADRA) through cohesion activities, strengthening European strategic autonomy in AI.
